title: Crawford memorial: William Glasgow gamekeeper, Janet Thomson and children

citations.name: William Glasgow
citations.type: Crawford memorial: William Glasgow gamekeeper, Janet Thomson and children
citations.assertion: William, gamekeeper to Earl of Hopetoun. Scottish Genealogy Society transcript: William died 26 April 1853 aged 74; wife Janet Thomson died 1 April 1845 aged 62; children John and James died in infancy, George died 21 July 1816 aged 7; Isabel died 27 November 1881 aged 73. Gravestone image uninspected. Earlier George is not the 1818 child. William Glasgow: William, gamekeeper to Earl of Hopetoun; George Glasgow: Later same-name child comparison; not the George who died in 1816 Reviewed 2026-10-31; Crawford family source receipts, reviewed 31 October 2026; private bundle retained.
